title: should render the experiments page shell with the new experiment button
verifies: the experiments list page mounts with its header and New button

title: should load the create experiment form with identity, task and scorers sections
verifies: the create form mounts its identity, task and scorers sections and submit button

title: should surface validation errors when the create form is submitted empty
verifies: an empty submit surfaces the required-name error and stays on the form

title: should render the playground bench with the run-all control and variable bar
verifies: the playground bench renders its title, run-all control, variable bar and window count

title: should ask for confirmation before resetting the playground
verifies: reset opens a confirmation dialog that dismisses without clearing on cancel

title: should render the experiments list grouped by dataset
verifies: the experiments browser renders dataset groups (seeded data required)

title: should render the experiment detail page with meta and results table
verifies: the detail page renders meta and the results table (seeded experiment required)

title: should render the compare page for a baseline and candidate pair
verifies: the compare page renders a comparison panel or empty state (two seeded experiments required)

title: should lock the dataset and show the clone title when cloning an experiment
verifies: the clone form shows the clone title and locks the dataset (seeded cloneable experiment required)
